LESSON: READING 15.4.1 INTENSIVE READING: POEMS

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 15
Topic 15.4: Reading 15.4.1 Intensive reading: Poems

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Reading 15.4.1 Intensive reading: Poems. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why is it important to relate ideas read in works of art to real life?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. explain why it is important to relate ideas learnt in poems to real life
2. identify the key elements of an email
3. apply the elements in writing an email
4. appreciate the importance of writing emails

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: READING 15.4.1 INTENSIVE READING: POEMS
This lesson teaches Reading 15.4.1 Intensive reading: Poems for Grade 9 ENGLISH.

STUDY STEPS
1. explain why it is important to relate ideas learnt in poems to real life
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. identify the key elements of an email
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. apply the elements in writing an email
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
4. appreciate the importance of writing emails
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Reading 15.4.1 Intensive reading: Poems using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Reading 15.4.1 Intensive reading: Poems above.
2. Explain Reading 15.4.1 Intensive reading: Poems to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Reading 15.4.1 Intensive reading: Poems.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reading 15.4.1 Intensive reading: Poems with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Reading 15.4.1 Intensive reading: Poems important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is it important to relate ideas read in works of art to real life?
2. What is the role of poems in the society?
3. Why do we write emails?
4. What is the difference between emails and letters?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. explain why it is important to relate ideas learnt in poems to real life
2. identify the key elements of an email
3. apply the elements in writing an email
4. appreciate the importance of writing emails

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
